definitions.explanation: A raised bank of earth built along a river or around a pond to hold back water. A somewhat literary word; {堤防|ていぼう} is the usual word in news and engineering, and {土手|どて} in everyday talk. It is also a common family name ({堤|つつみ}さん).

examples.english: To walk along the river bank.
Cherry trees are blooming along the embankment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{堤|つつみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れ→切れる：01936_kireru⟧、⟦{田|た}んぼ→田んぼ：00402_tanbo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧つかった。
examples.english: The heavy rain broke the embankment, and the rice fields were flooded.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {堤|つつみ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧: an embankment gives way
- {桜堤|さくらづつみ}: a bank lined with cherry trees

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{堤防|ていぼう}→堤防：19409_teibou⟧: embankment, levee; the standard word in news and flood control
- ⟦{土手|どて}→土手：12051_dote⟧: bank; the everyday word, often a grassy riverside slope

WATCH OUT:
⟦{包|つつ}み→包み：03524_tsutsumi⟧ (a package, a bundle) has the same reading but is a different word.
